description: This file defines the EmbedNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing an embed node in the template's abstract syntax tree. It extends the IncludeNode and manages how embedded templates are loaded and rendered.

classes.name: Twig\Node\EmbedNode
classes.description: Represents an embed node within the Twig templating engine, responsible for handling embedded templates during compilation and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmbedNode with template name, index, variables, and flags for only and ignoreMissing options.

methods.name: addGetTemplate
methods.description: Generates PHP code for loading a template, handling the ignore_missing flag.
